children: Longevity entered a securities purchase agreement with Puritan Partners to raise up to $625,000, drawing an initial $375,000 tranche.
Entered a Purchase Agreement with Puritan Partners for up to $694,445 principal (10% OID) yielding up to $625,000 gross proceeds.
Received $375,000 at initial closing via a 10% senior secured convertible note due Feb 29, 2028 (initial principal $416,667).
Note bears 10% interest, convertible at $0.50 per share, and is secured by substantially all company assets.
Up to $250,000 additional proceeds possible via two further tranches; second tranche requires an effective resale registration statement.
